labels: A pair of indoor slip-on shoes has pale low uppers; one heel cup remains upright while the other is visibly folded beneath the wearer's heel.; 밝고 낮은 갑피의 실내화 한 쌍 중 한쪽 뒤축은 서 있고 다른 쪽 뒤축은 착용자의 발뒤꿈치 아래로 접혀 있다.
definition: Complete optional school-life visual realization: A pair of indoor slip-on shoes has pale low uppers; one heel cup remains upright while the other is visibly folded beneath the wearer's heel.
aliases: 실내화와 뒤축 상태
